cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents Hill Anga men and children in a row outdoors playing long horns, wearing loin-cloths, head-cloths, and shoulder cloths, matching a genuine ethnographic scene of the claimed people's daily/ritual life.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, medium group of male Hill Anga adults and children. Standing in row outdoors, playing horns. Wearing loin-cloths, head-cloths, cloths across shoulder, some wearing arm-ornaments.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
